title: Using the Tote Insight Screen

children: You can use the Tote Insight Screen to search and manage tote in your warehouse.
The following is discussed in this topic:
You can use the Tote Insight Screen to search for and view work records in your warehouse.
Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search.
Press the Apply Filter Button. The system will display the resulting records in the List Pane.
If you select one of the result records from the List Pane, then the system will display its information in the Detail Pane.
The Tote Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic
The Tote Insight Screen's Detail Pane displays the specific field values associated with a selected record in the List Pane.
For more general information about the Detail Pane, see the topic

This action allows you to unassign the user from the selected tote. The system will remove the assigned user from the tote.

A successful message indicating the user has been unassigned form the tote is displayed.

        Searching/Viewing Work Records...
        You can use the Tote Insight Screen to search for and view work records in your warehouse. 
        
            Open the Tote Insight Screen.
            Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search.
            Press the Apply Filter Button. The system will display the resulting records in the List Pane. 
            If you select one of the result records from the List Pane, then the system will display its information in the Detail Pane.
        
         
        
         
        About the List Pane...
        
            The Tote Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
            For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic Introduction to Insight Screens.
        
         
        
         
        About the Detail Pane...
        
            The Tote Insight Screen's Detail Pane displays the specific field values associated with a selected record in the List Pane.
            For more general information about the Detail Pane, see the topic Introduction to Insight Screens.
        
         
        
         
        Screen Actions...
        The following actions are accessible from the List Pane:
         
        Unassign
        This action allows you to unassign the user from the selected tote. The system will remove the assigned user from the tote. 
         
        Procedure
        
        
            Navigate to the Putwall Insight screen
            Select a tote record and Actions >> Unassign.
            System will prompt user with confirmation message. Click Yes.
            A successful message indicating the user has been unassigned form the tote is displayed.

Screen Actions...

        
The following actions are accessible from the List Pane:

        
 

        
Unassign

        
This action allows you to unassign the user from the selected tote. The system will remove the assigned user from the tote. 

        
 

        
Procedure
        

        

            
Navigate to the Putwall Insight screen

            
Select a tote record and Actions >> Unassign.

            
System will prompt user with confirmation message. Click Yes.

            
A successful message indicating the user has been unassigned form the tote is displayed.
